data.narrative:
Askari Defense operates in the Defense & Security sector at an undisclosed stage with three founders (Robert van Zyl, Marc van Zyl, and Benjamin Airdo). The broader comp universe includes 26 same-sector peers, of which 2 are publicly traded (DRSHF, IDEAFORGE.NS) and 8 are private. Notable private comparables include Anduril Industries, Helsing, Castelion, Shield AI, and Saronic.

Peer-median valuation methodology is not applicable here. The Defense & Security sector contains 26 companies total, but filtering for same-stage, adjacent-stage, or similar-valuation-tier peers yielded fewer than three datapoints in any narrow category. Using the full-sector median would introduce unacceptable selection bias given the heterogeneity in stage and valuation tiers across defense firms.

Without sufficient narrow-peer triangulation, traditional comparable-company analysis cannot be reliably executed. A complete valuation would require supplementary approaches—such as discounted cash flow, precedent transactions in the Defense & Security space, or venture-specific stage priors—none of which are provided in the dataset. The key uncertainty remains the absence of adequate stage-matched or valuation-tier-matched peers, making quantitative benchmarking premature. Additional financial data from Askari or tighter comparable selection criteria would be necessary to establish a defensible valuation range.
